entities.name: Methylamine
observations: The SELFIES fragment [C][N] resolves to methylamine, CH3NH2.
Acts as the nucleophile in the proposed SNAr reaction.

entities.name: Methanol
observations: The SELFIES fragment [C][O] resolves to methanol, CH3OH.
Best interpreted as solvent or proton-transfer medium; incorporation into the product is not supported when methylamine is present.

entities.name: Trichloropyrimidine
observations: The chlorinated heteroaromatic resolves to Clc1ncc(Cl)c(Cl)n1, a pyrimidine-type ring with two ring nitrogens and three chlorine substituents.
It is an electron-poor heteroaryl electrophile suitable for SNAr amination.

entities.name: Pyrimidine SNAr amination
observations: Methylamine plausibly replaces one ring C–Cl bond on the chlorinated pyrimidine, leaving two chlorines.
The exact regioisomer is not proven by the available analog records.

entities.name: N-Methylamino-dichloropyrimidine
observations: Plausible major product: a mono-(methylamino) dichloropyrimidine formed by replacing one chlorine with –NHCH3.
One representative positional isomer is N-methyl-5,6-dichloropyrimidin-2-amine, SMILES CNc1ncc(Cl)c(Cl)n1; positional assignment remains tentative.
